title: Preparing together for the labour room

scenes.caption: Choose your support person
scenes.narration_line: Choose someone you trust to accompany you and offer reassurance during labour.

scenes.caption: Talk through your birth preferences
scenes.narration_line: Review your birth preferences together, including what support you want and what you would rather avoid.

scenes.caption: Prepare together for the hospital
scenes.narration_line: Check what to pack and what to expect at your maternity unit together.

scenes.caption: Offer calm, practical comfort
scenes.narration_line: Your partner can offer encouragement, hold your hand, or gently massage your back.

scenes.caption: Help communicate changing needs
scenes.narration_line: Your partner can help explain your needs to staff and support your decisions, even when your preferences change.
safety_points: Your preferences can change during labour.
